note: Phase 2: flow_cards + REAL benchmark_history, both grounded in iteration1 DSE (4 of 13 benchmarks). History is sent UNFILTERED (Phase 3 adds relevance retrieval). Human review required before trusting.

phys_opt.description: Runs Vivado phys_opt_design in post-place and post-route passes (fanout replication, critical-cell opt, DSP/BRAM register moves, LUT restructure) to cut critical-path delay.
avoid_when: already applied twice on the same DCP (diminishing returns)
WNS far worse than -5ns where placement is the real problem
phys_opt.notes: Highest scorer base prior (3.0) and the deterministic fallback flow. Non-destructive (no netlist rewrite). DSE n=4: the +max is driven by the tiny vexriscv_re-place design (high variance across design sizes); the median is the robust figure. 4/4 verified.

auto_pblock.description: Queries the FPGA fabric via RapidWright to find an optimal contiguous region, then unplaces and re-places spread-out cells into it and re-routes.
avoid_when: compact designs that are already well-clustered
logicnets or vexriscv (use their dedicated flows)
auto_pblock.notes: Re-places large regions, so it can regress as well as help (DSE fmax_min negative). +max driven by vexriscv_re-place. 4/4 verified.

congestion_spread.description: Uses Vivado congestion analysis then placement/routing-focused phys_opt passes to relieve pressure from timing-critical congested regions.
avoid_when: low failing-endpoint count / already converged designs
congestion_spread.notes: phys_opt-based, non-destructive. +max driven by vexriscv_re-place. 4/4 verified.

memory_path_opt.description: Targets BRAM/DSP-heavy critical paths with phys_opt options tuned for memory-interface timing (bram/dsp/uram register opt, bram_enable_opt, critical_pin_opt, equ_drivers_opt).
avoid_when: LUT-dominated designs with few hard blocks
memory_path_opt.notes: Best median fmax delta of the phys_opt family on the covered set. +max driven by vexriscv_re-place. 4/4 verified.

hardblock_relocate.description: Timing extraction plus hard-block-aware phys_opt to encourage BRAM/DSP register movement and critical-cell relocation near hard blocks.
avoid_when: designs with few hard blocks

retime.description: Moves flip-flops across combinational logic (Vivado phys_opt_design AlternateFlowWithRetiming) to balance pipeline-stage delays.
use_when: FF count > LUT count (register-heavy / deeply pipelined designs)
avoid_when: combinational-dominated designs with few registers
retime.notes: Retiming preserves function (4/4 verified). A pblock->retime chain (pblock_retime) was swept in DSE, evidence that retime composes after placement flows. +max driven by vexriscv_re-place.

net_swap.description: phys_opt options for LUT pin swapping (critical_pin_opt) and rewiring loads to equivalent drivers (equ_drivers_opt).
use_when: LUT pin-swap or equivalent-driver opportunities on critical paths
avoid_when: designs with no equivalent-driver / pin-swap headroom
net_swap.notes: Logically-equivalent rewiring, low risk (4/4 verified). +max driven by vexriscv_re-place.

lut_cone.description: RapidWright LUTInputConeOpt merges chains of small LUTs on critical paths into single larger (<=6-input) LUTs to cut logic depth.
use_when: critical paths with many LUT-to-LUT hops
avoid_when: DSP/BRAM-heavy designs
lut_cone.notes: Netlist restructuring (merges LUTs). LOW-CONFIDENCE numerics: its target family (logicnets) is NOT among the 4 covered benchmarks, so the DSE here is off-target (median negative). 4/4 verified.

fanout.description: Replicates the source driver of high-fanout nets (>100) on critical paths via RapidWright, then re-routes.
use_when: high-fanout nets (>100 loads) on critical paths
avoid_when: low-fanout or already-optimised designs
fanout.notes: Driver replication is logically safe (4/4 verified). Legacy general flow (the run_test base). +max driven by vexriscv_re-place.

pblock.description: Applies a known-optimal hardcoded pblock region (SLICE_X55Y60:SLICE_X111Y254) for LogicNets JSCL: re-places cells into it and re-routes.
avoid_when: any non-logicnets-jscl design (the region is design-specific)
pblock.notes: Benchmark-specific. The pblock->retime chain (pblock_retime) was swept separately in DSE. LOW-CONFIDENCE numerics: logicnets_jscl (its target) is NOT among the 4 covered benchmarks. 4/4 verified.

vexriscv.description: Benchmark-specific flow: RapidWright net-detour analysis then optimize_cell_placement for the VexRiscv re-place design, then re-route and verify.
avoid_when: any non-vexriscv design - large regressions observed (fmax_min around -140 MHz on vexriscv_re-place_v2)
vexriscv.notes: Benchmark-specific; only positive on its own target design. 4/4 verified.

congestion_spread_rw.description: RapidWright-assisted variant of congestion_spread: runs a net-detour pre-pass before the spreading passes.
use_when: same situations as congestion_spread, when a RapidWright detour pre-pass may help routing
avoid_when: QoR-sensitive runs - widest downside of the set (fmax_min around -109 MHz)
runs requiring guaranteed equivalence (RapidWright rewrite)
congestion_spread_rw.notes: Thin wrapper: detour pre-pass + congestion_spread. Not in the default allowlist. 4/4 verified but high QoR variance.

memory_path_opt_rw.description: RapidWright-assisted variant of memory_path_opt with a net-detour pre-pass.
use_when: same situations as memory_path_opt, when a routing detour pre-pass may help
avoid_when: runs requiring guaranteed functional equivalence - 1 of 4 DSE runs FAILED equivalence
QoR-sensitive runs (fmax_min around -65 MHz)
memory_path_opt_rw.notes: HIGHEST-RISK card: 3/4 verified - one equivalence failure observed in DSE. Thin wrapper over memory_path_opt. Not in the default allowlist.

hardblock_relocate_rw.description: RapidWright-assisted variant of hardblock_relocate with a net-detour pre-pass.
use_when: same situations as hardblock_relocate, when a detour pre-pass may help
avoid_when: QoR-sensitive runs (fmax_min around -50 MHz)
runs requiring guaranteed equivalence (RapidWright rewrite)
hardblock_relocate_rw.notes: Thin wrapper: detour pre-pass + hardblock_relocate. Not in the default allowlist. 4/4 verified.

auto_top3.description: Meta-flow: ranks all primitive flows by the deterministic heuristic, runs the top three independently from the same input DCP, and keeps the best Fmax/WNS result.
use_when: unsure which single flow to pick - explores the three highest-prior flows and keeps the best
avoid_when: tight runtime budget (runs three flows sequentially)
inside the LLM expansion policy - this is a CLI test-mode meta-flow and is NOT in allowed_flows
auto_top3.notes: Not represented in the iteration1 DSE (it is a selector, not a primitive), so typical_fmax_delta_mhz is null and listed in needs_more_data. runtime_class 'slow' is code-reasoned (it executes three flows), not DSE-measured.

excluded_flows.pblock_retime: Has real DSE data (n=4) but is NOT in this checkout's run_test_mode dispatch (it originates from the contest checkout's code). Excluded by developer decision; re-add a card if/when it becomes dispatchable here.

low_confidence_cards.lut_cone: target family (logicnets) not among the 4 covered benchmarks; numerics off-target
low_confidence_cards.pblock: target (logicnets_jscl) not among the 4 covered benchmarks; numerics off-target
low_confidence_cards.auto_top3: no DSE row; runtime_class reasoned not measured

needs_more_data.notes: Every typical_fmax_delta_mhz is min/median/max over n<=4 DSE runs on {rosetta_spam-filter, vexriscv_re-place, vexriscv_re-place_v2, vtr_mcml}. The +max is frequently driven by the tiny vexriscv_re-place design (high variance); prefer the median. Schema has no runtime_seconds field, so measured runtimes were bucketed into runtime_class (fast<=180s, medium<=450s, slow>450s by DSE median).

null_design_signals.avg_spread_tiles: present in only ~13% of runs; unreliable
null_design_signals.max_spread_tiles: present in only ~13% of runs; unreliable
null_design_signals.signal_fingerprint: depends on signals not uniformly available

benchmark_history.lut_capture_failures_note: These runs recorded initial_utilization.luts=0 (a capture failure in some _rw flows; their ffs/final_luts are non-zero). lut_count, complexity_class, utilisation_pct and ff_gt_lut are null for them, not fabricated.
benchmark_history.history_notes: All records are single-flow from baseline (graph_depth=1, was_first_flow=true, flow_sequence_before=[]); multi-step history awaits later iterations. flow_applied='pblock_retime' has history records but no flow_card (excluded in Phase 1). notes are templated (deterministic), not LLM-generated.
